meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 在完成编辑操作后会自动检查代码中的注释问题。如果发现注释不符合规范，Claude 会收到警告并需要修复或解释问题，然后才能继续工作。
howto.when: 当 Claude 成功执行 apply_patch、write、edit、multi_edit 或 multiedit 等编辑操作后，自动触发注释检查。

say.text: 检查我刚修改的代码中的注释。
say.note: 触发注释检查并获取反馈。

say.text: 解释为什么这段注释有问题。
say.note: Claude 会说明注释不符合规范的原因。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically checks comments in code after edit operations. If a comment issue is found, Claude receives a warning and must fix or explain it before proceeding.
howto.when_en: Triggered automatically after successful apply_patch, write, edit, multi_edit, or multiedit operations.

say_en.text: Check the comments in the code I just edited.
say_en.note: Triggers comment check and gets feedback.

say_en.text: Explain why this comment is problematic.
say_en.note: Claude explains the reason for the comment warning.
